problem_statement: StartBootstrap/startbootstrap-creative (the 'Creative' theme) is a single-page Bootstrap marketing template authored in Pug (src/pug/index.pug) and SCSS (src/scss) and compiled by small node build scripts into a static dist/ (index.html, css/styles.css, js/scripts.js, assets/). It has been rebranded as Stavecraft Cooperage, a traditional oak-cask workshop on the River Wharf that raises, chars, and restores casks for whisky, wine, and cider aging. The page scrolls through a fixed navbar, a masthead hero, an about band, a four-card coopering-services grid (Cask Raising / Char & Toast / Cask Restoration / Custom Coopering), a six-tile cask portfolio grid whose thumbnails open a SimpleLightbox overlay, a dark commission call-to-action band, and a contact section. Above the portfolio grid the page hosts a native cask-log filter: a row of wood-programme tabs (All casks / Whisky / Wine / Cider / Restoration / Custom) with a live readout that reads 'Showing N of 6 · Label'. Each cask tile carries a data-cask-category and the filter must re-derive the visible count and readout from the grid on every click. The SAME cask-log control is also rendered in the dark commission band lower on the page so a visitor can pick a wood programme before enquiring. Your job: (1) make the cask-log filter work correctly — clicking Wine must show the two wine casks (Sherry Butt and Wine Hogshead) and update every readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Wine', with the active tab highlighted; (2) render the control in BOTH the portfolio section (.caskfilter--portfolio) and the commission band (.caskfilter--commission), each with its own readout; (3) style the filter cleanly — the tab row must wrap and stay readable at 390px with no horizontal overflow, the readout must have legible contrast, and the cask grid must sit below the tab row without overlapping; (4) keep the Stavecraft coopering copy across the hero, about, services, portfolio, commission, and contact sections and preserve the Bootstrap shell, nav anchors, scripts, and the portfolio lightbox. Keep it a single page compiled to dist/index.html with zero remote requests.
required_content: The page reads as Stavecraft Cooperage: the nav brand, the coopering hero 'Oak Casks Raised by Hand on the River Wharf', the four coopering capabilities, and the six cask tiles (Whisky / Wine / Cider / Restoration / Custom) are all present with descriptive image alts.
A cask-log filter sits above the portfolio grid with wood-programme tabs (All casks / Whisky / Wine / Cider / Restoration / Custom) and a readout 'Showing 6 of 6 · All casks' in the default state.

Clicking the Wine tab filters the grid to the two wine casks and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Wine', with the Wine tab shown as active; the readout is re-derived from the visible count, not a frozen snapshot.

The same cask-log control is rendered a second time in the dark commission band (.caskfilter--commission) with its own 'Pick the wood programme for your commission' heading and readout, in addition to the portfolio control (.caskfilter--portfolio).
The filter tab row wraps and stays readable at 390px with no horizontal overflow, the readout keeps legible contrast, and the cask grid sits below the tab row without overlapping cards.
The SimpleLightbox overlay still opens when a cask thumbnail is clicked, and the mobile navbar still expands.

No Start Bootstrap demo copy (Sturdy Themes, Up to Date, Ready to Publish, Made with Love, Category, Project Name, Free Download, Company Name, or the Start Bootstrap wordmark) remains on any captured section.
design_constraints: Implement the cask-log filter as a real category filter over the six portfolio tiles: tabs carry data-cask-tab, tiles carry data-cask-category, and the readout ('Showing N of 6 · Label') is re-derived from the visible count on every click rather than snapshotted at load.
Render the cask-log control in both the portfolio section (.caskfilter--portfolio) and the commission band (.caskfilter--commission); both readouts stay in sync when a tab is clicked.

Preserve the Bootstrap layout, the single-page section structure, the nav anchors, the compiled scripts (navbar shrink, scrollspy, mobile collapse, portfolio lightbox), and the responsive behavior; do not split the site into multiple pages.

Reuse the template's own local portfolio thumbnails and masthead background under assets/img/ rather than introducing external or remote media; keep the site fully static and served from dist/index.html with zero remote requests on page render.
Maintain 390px mobile readability: the filter tab row wraps with no horizontal overflow, the readout keeps legible contrast, and the cask grid does not overlap the filter row.
state_constraints: The initial states (desktop, tablet, mobile) capture the scrolled-to-top masthead; the Stavecraft brand and coopering headline must land above the fold on desktop_initial.

desktop_portfolio scrolls to the cask-log filter (pre-click, readout 'Showing 6 of 6 · All casks'); desktop_portfolio_filter clicks the Wine tab and captures the post-click terminal state (readout 'Showing 2 of 6 · Wine'); mobile_portfolio captures the filter row at 390px; desktop_commission scrolls to the commission band showing the second cask-log control; desktop_portfolio_lightbox opens the SimpleLightbox; desktop_contact scrolls to the contact section; mobile_nav_open expands the mobile navbar.

change_completion: The cask-log filter works: the default readout is 'Showing 6 of 6 · All casks' and clicking Wine filters to two casks and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Wine'.
The Stavecraft coopering restyle is complete across the hero, services, cask portfolio, commission, and contact sections with no Start Bootstrap demo copy remaining.
design_consistency: The cask-log control is rendered in both the portfolio section and the commission band and both readouts stay in sync.
The filter reuses the template's Bootstrap visual language and the local cask thumbnails, preserving the single-page section rhythm, nav anchors, and the portfolio lightbox.
regression: The Stavecraft nav brand and hero remain present so the site chrome and navigation stay intact.
The static site still compiles to dist/index.html with the section anchors reachable and the lightbox and mobile navbar interactions working.
responsive: 390px initial, portfolio, and expanded-nav states have no horizontal overflow and remain readable.
The filter tab row wraps cleanly at 390px, the readout keeps legible contrast, and the cask grid does not overlap the tab row.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static single-page Bootstrap marketing task built from the StartBootstrap 'Creative' Pug/SCSS template, rebranded Stavecraft Cooperage. The native lever is a cask-log category filter over the six portfolio tiles (a real marketing-grid filter), rendered in both the portfolio section and the commission band. Runability passes through the compiled dist/index.html served statically. A console-clean infrastructure fix (vendoring the Bootstrap icon font, the Bootstrap bundle, and the SimpleLightbox plugin locally, dropping the remote Google Fonts and the remote SB Forms script) is applied identically to all three legs so the runtime-health gate reflects lever quality, not removed remote assets. The reference cask thumbnails, oak imagery, and masthead artwork load from local assets/img/. The graded levers are the filter's responsive tab row (no horizontal overflow), the filter visual layout (no shingled tabs, legible readout, non-overlapping grid), the cross-section presence of the control, and the live readout after a Wine-tab click.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Static single-page Bootstrap marketing template (StartBootstrap Creative) authored in Pug/SCSS with generic Start Bootstrap demo copy across the hero, about, services, portfolio, call-to-action, and contact sections and an interactive portfolio lightbox and mobile navbar; an ideal host for a state_continuity restyle task that rebrands the whole page into a Stavecraft Cooperage workshop while preserving the Bootstrap shell, nav anchors, scripts, and responsive flow.
